description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasActionTrust class, verifying URL trust logic in different scenarios related to trusted canvas actions and origins.

classes.name: CanvasActionTrustTest
classes.description: Test suite for CanvasActionTrust URL verification functions

methods.name: acceptsBundledScaffoldAsset
methods.description: Tests that a predefined scaffold asset URL is recognized as trusted

methods.name: acceptsTrustedA2uiPageOnAdvertisedCanvasHost
methods.description: Verifies that a trusted A2UI page URL on a specific canvas host is accepted

methods.name: rejectsDifferentOriginEvenIfPathMatches
methods.description: Ensures URLs from different origins are rejected even if their paths match

methods.name: rejectsUntrustedCanvasPagePathOnTrustedOrigin
methods.description: Confirms that untrusted page paths on a trusted origin are rejected

methods.name: acceptsFragmentOnlyDifferenceForTrustedA2uiPage
methods.description: Tests that URL differences in fragments (hash) are accepted if base URLs match

methods.name: rejectsQueryMismatchOnTrustedOriginAndPath
methods.description: Checks that URL query mismatches result in rejection

methods.name: rejectsDescendantPathUnderTrustedA2uiRoot
methods.description: Verifies that paths under the trusted A2UI root, which are not explicitly trusted, are rejected
